design_changes.change: Make immutable call-scoped invocation identity mandatory across the full effect lifecycle. Prefer host tool_use_id when present; otherwise mint an equally exact invocation_id at deterministic ingress. session_id remains context only and must not be the sole effect correlation key.
design_changes.reason: Current donor writes one active_turns.effect_id selected by session_id, while the current Claude Code hook contract exposes call-scoped tool_use_id and parallel tool execution semantics.

design_changes.change: Replace overloaded donor effects.status semantics with distinct typed states/receipts: ADMISSION_DECISION, ENFORCEMENT_DECISION, EXECUTION_RECEIPT, WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION, RESULT_REENTRY and COMPLETION_EVIDENCE.
design_changes.reason: Donor PostToolUse fallback can mint VERIFIED without any PreToolUse row; VERIFIED therefore does not prove prior admission.

design_changes.change: Place real deny/allow authority at the deterministic host/executor boundary that can actually prevent execution. Lifecycle hooks may remain adapters/audit surfaces, but bookkeeping statuses are never enforcement authority.
design_changes.reason: Current cmd_hook proves the hook surface can deny for session-bound SEBUKKU, yet ordinary zulassen() deliberately emits no blocking decision.

design_changes.change: Treat process-topology changes, long-lived module caches, dispatcher field completeness and schema generation as explicit typed compatibility/freshness contracts rather than incidental implementation details.
design_changes.reason: Historical donor lineage reports failures after subprocess-to-in-process transition, dropped outcome payload fields and unified.db schema lag. These remain historical evidence, not current runtime promotion.
design_changes.target: GRID10 persistent runtime and UnifiedDB adapters

design_changes.change: Keep both Triggerword-5 append-only provenance lanes readable until a migration receipt explicitly resolves architecture_archaeology versus frankenstein_architecture_ingest authority. Consume by immutable packet/run IDs with semantic dedupe rather than path aliasing.
design_changes.reason: Both namespaces are actively moving and contain non-identical successor packets.

counterhypotheses: The exact installed Claude Code scheduler may serialize the relevant state-changing calls; this can bound runtime race exposure but does not justify a weaker Frankenstein-2.0 identity ABI when call-scoped identity is already available.
A host-only wache-koenig predecessor may already be the actual blocking gate. If exact source proves this, adapt its enforcement role rather than forcing stern.py itself to become the gate.
triggerword4_acceptance_contract_delta: Two same-session state-changing tool calls must retain distinct invocation/effect identities from PreToolUse through result/re-entry even when executed in one parallel batch.
DENY/UNKNOWN admission cannot be upgraded by a later successful tool return.
Observed successful outcome without a bound admission receipt remains observed outcome with zero admitted-effect credit.
Unknown or transport-ambiguous external effect outcome remains UNKNOWN and is never blindly replayed.
A real deny decision must be proven at the host/executor boundary, not inferred from a journal status.
Schema/config generation mismatch must fail closed or produce explicit degraded/unknown state rather than silent stale behavior.
next_exact_gate: Acquire or definitively classify unavailable the host-only wache-koenig artifact; then trace realtime_gespraech tool execution and all downstream effects.status consumers, and recover exact Git windows for effect/config/schema semantics before Triggerword-4 implementation promotion.
